page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.2xlarge is a KVM-based virtual machine powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with an x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core, and includes a bundled 959 GB local SSD. Network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower-to-average tiers. The Intel Xeon 8163 CPU demonstrates weak single-core and multi-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench tests, falling into the bottom 25%. However, it achieves average results in Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests. Memory read bandwidth is generally weak, but large block write bandwidth reaches average levels. Redis SET operations perform well, reaching 6.1 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput is measured at 4.3 GB/sec. Small-scale LLM inference with a 135M model is average, but performance drops significantly to the bottom 10% for medium-sized 7B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i2gne.2xlarge offers a balanced resource density for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation and substantial local SSD storage without demanding top-tier compute speeds. The bundled 959 GB SSD provides high-capacity local storage, making it suitable for database operations, caching layers like Redis, and general-purpose applications that benefit from local storage but do not require intensive CPU or memory performance.
